messages.text: can i preorder now?
Read the harlo h15 dual page
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Bitcoin Dogecoin
Looked something up in Shopify

Not yet. Batch 1 opens Wednesday, September 30 at 12pm ET, 50 units, $999. Those units ship November 14, 2026.

Worth setting a reminder, 50 goes fast. It's 15 TH/s on Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s on Dogecoin, about 450W, and the plug is matched to your address.

Want me to run the earnings numbers for where you live before Wednesday?
I have a reminder set; not too concerned on the "numbers", its more of a money losing (currently) hobby for me. LOL
Used the chat-interview skill

Ha, fair enough. Most home miners are in it for the lottery ticket and the fun of running one.

Wednesday at noon ET, then. Anything you want to know about the H15 before that? Noise, setup, whether it does both coins at once.
No, I see the specs, interesting it does both BTC and Doge, see how it works I guess. Thanks
Before you go, one thing: what made the dual BTC and Doge unit catch your eye over a straight Bitcoin miner?
I have small machines, have bought from you before, and just the price and concept interested me.
What's the concept part, the two coins in one box, or the size and power draw?
2 coins at once mostly; power draw and noise both features that I look at.
Makes sense. Last one: what are you running now, and where do they sit in the house?

I have 2 small Avalon machines (nano3 and Avalon Q) at home , in a closed garage during the most of the year in a room I dont use during cold winter months. And a Dgoe3 and cedg1m at my office. I usually shut them down June/July/August because of summer electric rates.
That's useful, thanks. Good luck Wednesday at noon ET.

see, very small. i really got into the crypto stuff a year or so ago to see if I wanted to make some investments in that "world" and where the best investment space would be; leaning to the services side, like Coinbase, etc...

Makes sense, the picks and shovels side. I won't steer you on investments, that's out of my lane, but running the hardware yourself is a decent way to learn what's actually hard about it.

Catch you Wednesday at noon ET for the batch.
thanks, i will try to pick one up Wednesday, if not, I ll try the next batch!

Sounds good. 50 units in batch 1, so set the reminder a few minutes early. If it sells out, there will be another batch and I can tell you the date once it's posted.

Enjoy the mining.

context.pop: Hey, it's Sarah. Noticed you've been looking at Harlo H15 Dual — Bitcoin + Dogecoin. Want me to run the numbers for where you live, or answer anything before you decide?
